correctness.rationale: The complement equivalence is exact for degree 3. A crossing-edge inequality proves the upper bound 12 and five constructions witness equality. Independent direct C++ bitmask and inductive Python algorithms each examine the entire \(2^{20}\)-subset domain and agree on the face/facet coefficients 62049 and 844. The natural 240-map group action partitions all 844 facets into 12 certified orbits. All sixty valid eleven-sets extend uniquely to the five twelve-sets; each statement has a complete certificate in the embedded code.

value.rationale: The facet spectrum and full face polynomial complete natural induced-degree-one and global offensive alliance invariants on the canonical Desargues incidence graph. The missing minimal-alliance cardinality nine, the five geometrically rigid optimum types and the unique extension of all 60 near-maximum dissociation sets give structural interpretations not captured by the easy minimum bound. A complete finite classification and its orbit types are reusable exact benchmark data; no general-family theorem is claimed.
